title: If You Go Crazy, Dance Until You Die

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff... That's twenty sprints,
complete. Which means we're
done for
today, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our training's been going smoothly all
through summer camp.
Everything's great,
so why does it feel like... like...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Man, you really need to work on
your poker face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... C'mere, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leads me out into the woods, taking
me deeper and deeper into
the wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so we're definitely going the right
way. Now we've just gotta
go straight until
we get outta the trees.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're headed to a stretch of beach that's
supposed to have a killer
view. The woods
are so thick, though, even the locals don't
risk it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and me are gonna put our lives up on
the table—the payout's
having the best
beach to ourselves. It's all up to chance
what happens
next.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Us versus the woods—whoever wins, wins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that no one's been through these
woods in ages. They're
unsettlingly
overgrown, and definitely dangerous. We
can't even see
ahead of us, so I should
stop her, but I... I can't.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... At least half the planks on this
bridge have rotted off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you've got some crazy good luck,
having the plank beneath
you fall without
goin' with it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, a dead end. I guess we could double
back and look for a way
around the cliff.
Or...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Now you're talkin'! You're getting
as bad as me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We walk and walk, the woods growing
darker as night falls. There's
not even a
bead of moonlight to guide us, and I'm
starting to hear
rustles and roars...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at the claw marks on this tree.
What do you wanna bet that
a bear did
this? An actual, real, wild bear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wait... what am I saying? What am I doing? My trainee and I are potentially in mortal danger, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a low growl in the distance, then the
snapping of branches. The
rustle of
leaves... Some creature is slowly getting
closer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, speak of the devil, huh? Luck is really playin' a game with us tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Yeah. Yeah, it's showtime now.
We don't got any choice
left but to play
big and go all in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Roar!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Here it comes. RUN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run blindly, wildly through the darkness. This is easily the dumbest, riskiest thing I've ever done, but... in spite of that... because of that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can sense everything. The hairs on my neck bristle with the bear's every breath. My head's on fire, each step echoing like a feverish pulse. My whole body's in overdrive trying to cheat death.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Hey, this is bad huh?! Crazy, right? Let's up the ante even higher! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel a sudden, inhumanly powerful yank,
and I'm sent reeling...
upwards? The world
spins upside down, bouncing as trees blur
past. I
belatedly realize it's Nakayama,
holding me as she runs.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaaah! It's on, bear! Come outrun
me—IF YOU CAN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa charges ahead, giving no
hint of stopping, even long
after we
manage to shake the bear. And then,
abruptly, the darkness
dissipates.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Hah... Hahh... We, we made it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huff... Huff... Dammit. That dumb bear...
came outta nowhere... Huff...
Runnin' after
us... That was, one hell of, of...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flop!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ahahahaha! Man, it sure was!
Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us lie in the sand, laughing like
maniacs. Just... the whole
experience was
so crazy, I can't help it. My hands are
trembling, and
it kinda dawns on me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I saw myself reflected in the store's
window, I had this dazed
grin. The biggest,
most satisfied-looking smile I'd ever seen
on
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, and now... The sensation
tingling through my body, the

uncontrollable shake in my hands... That's
not fear.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, c'mon. You just figured that out now? How oblivious are you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But... if you want another hit of that high,
I'll give it to you. Here,
look over that way.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Us two... we just scored the jackpot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The full moon burns with a cold light,
casting a shining path on the
dark waves
that leads my eyes up to the night sky,
where a panoramic
view of the galaxy
envelops us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of my life being on the line still
burns in my veins. The pure
unfiltered joy
of the beautiful treasure we won washes
through my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You look completely out of it.
Don't tell me that one round of
the game
burned up all your stamina already.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're not down for the count
yet, huh? Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just keep comin' with me. I'll take you
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod, silently. I'll keep chasing that
hair-raising, heart-pounding high
with her
till the two of us break.
